title.en: sunday upmarket at the old truman brewery.
title.de: sunday upmarket im old truman brewery.

line.en: street food and a retail section, open 10:00 to 18:00 on sundays. a late-morning start from brick lane, then lunch under the arches.
line.de: streetfood und ein verkaufsbereich, sonntags 10 bis 18 uhr offen. ein später vormittag ab der brick lane, dann mittagessen unter den bögen.
line.tr: sokak yemekleri ve bir satış bölümü, pazar günleri 10:00 ile 18:00 arası açık. brick lane'den öğlene doğru başla, sonra kemerlerde öğle yemeği ye.

sparks.why: Sunday Upmarket at the Old Truman Brewery, Brick Lane, Sunday 10:00 to 18:00 per Visit London and Tripomatic; not checked on the venue site for 29 Nov.
